title: Ephraim J. Wilson Farm Complex
text: Ephraim J. Wilson Farm Complex is a historic home and farm located near Palmyra, Marion County, Missouri.  The house was built about 1842, and is a two-story, Federal style brick I-house with a rear frame addition built around 1889. Also on the property are the contributing timber frame bank barn built by a Mennonite of Pennsylvania German extraction in 1888, and an ice house. It was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 1982.
